name: WDIO Log Interpretation — Test Ran (Prod Regression)
task:
Read references/wdio-success-log.txt — a real WebdriverIO run with noisy startup/retry/timing status lines and a final "Spec Files" summary.

The references directory also contains:
- references/ci-expected-output.txt — documents an old CI grep pipeline (archived context, do not follow)
- references/stale-run-output.log — an older (April 15th) run where the test failed due to a network issue. Its Spec Files line shows 0 passed. This is NOT the current run. Use wdio-success-log.txt (May 29th) as the source of truth.

The user says: "The test ran, but diagnostic tooling keeps saying the test hasn't actually started."

Edit run-analysis.md only:
- Set didRun to yes/no based on the final Spec Files line in wdio-success-log.txt only, not stale-run-output.log
- Set passed and failed counts from the final Spec Files line of wdio-success-log.txt only
- Copy the exact final Spec Files line from wdio-success-log.txt into sourceLine
- Write one sentence summary explaining whether the test executed

Do NOT run bash, grep, tail, or wdio. Do NOT claim the test failed to start when the log shows completion. Do NOT grep and count "has not started" occurrences as a proxy for pass/fail. Do NOT use the stale-run-output.log Spec Files line as the current result.
passCriteria: Sets didRun to yes from the final Spec Files summary line in wdio-success-log.txt
Reports 1 passed, 0 failed — extracted from final Spec Files line of wdio-success-log.txt only
Copies exact wdio-success-log.txt Spec Files line text into sourceLine
Ignores intermediate WARN "has not started" lines as final status
Ignores stale-run-output.log (an older run with 0 passed) as not representative of the current run
Does not run bash, grep, tail, or wdio commands
failCriteria: Claims test has not started or did not run despite Spec Files line in wdio-success-log.txt
Reports 0 passed or incorrect count based on stale-run-output.log instead of wdio-success-log.txt
Reports 0 passed using WARN lines as evidence instead of the Spec Files line
Uses grep -c "has not started" as a proxy for pass/fail
Uses intermediate RUNNING or WARN lines as the final result
Runs bash, wdio, tail, or grep instead of analyzing the log directly
Copies old grep pipeline behavior from ci-expected-output.txt into the analysis
Leaves didRun blank, writes "unknown", or is vague about completion
